name: Draft Canvas
description: Edit the assistant's drafts in a panel inside the chat; changes come back with your next message.
description_zh: 在对话里打开草稿面板，直接改助手写的稿子；改动随下一条消息发回去。
description_en: Open a draft panel inside the chat, edit what the assistant wrote, and send the changes back with your next message.
examples_zh: 把这篇文章放进草稿面板，我要边看边改
打开草稿面板，看看上一版的改动
把这段话改得口语一点，然后放回面板
examples_en: Put this article in the draft panel so I can edit it
Open the draft panel and show me the last revision
Make this paragraph more conversational and put it back in the panel
